grammar_focus: 将来完成时(will have + 过去分词,表到将来某时刻已完成:by the end of this year / in a year's time,KS13)主考——对比一般将来(will finish)与将来进行(will be building)+ 将来被动(will be held)+ look forward to + 动名词(to 是介词)/ as = 因为·当(状语从句连词)(辅考·课文①类)
scene: 4年以后,奥林匹克运动会将在我们国家举行。由于将有大批人到来,政府将建造一些新饭店、一座大型体育场和一个新的奥运会标准游泳池,还要修一些新道路和一条铁路专线。奥运会将在首都郊外举行,整个地区将被称为'奥林匹克城'。工人们将在今年年底前把新路修好;到明年年底,他们将把新体育场建成。这些巨大的现代化建筑是由库尔特·冈特设计的。大家都将急切地注视着新建筑一点点建起来。我们都非常激动,盼望着奥运会的到来,因为在这个国家里还从未举办过奥运会。

grammar_card.title: 将来完成时:到将来某时已完成
grammar_card.intro: 将来完成时用 will have + 过去分词,表示到将来某一时刻(by + 时间点 / in … time)已经完成的动作。跟一般将来时(will do)、将来进行时(will be doing)不同。全用本课和 Key structures 的句子举例。

rows: 将来完成 → will have + 过去分词
Workers will have completed the roads by the end of this year.
一般将来 → will + 原形
They will finish it next year.
将来进行 → will be + doing
The government will be building new hotels.
将来被动 → will be + 过去分词
The Games will be held here.
by / in … time 时间标志
by the end of next year / in a year's time

specialRules.rule: look forward to 的 to 是介词,后面接名词或动名词:looking forward to the Games / to seeing you。
as 作连词可表'因为'(As many people will visit…)或'当/正值'(as the buildings go up)。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — When was the last time this country hosted the Olympic Games?
options: Never — they have never been held here before

passage: The Olympic Games will be held in our country in four years' time. As a great many people will be visiting the country, the government will be building new hotels, an immense stadium, and a new Olympic-standard swimming pool. They will also be building new roads and a special railroad line. The Games will be held just outside the capital, and the whole area will be called 'Olympic City'. Workers will have completed the new roads by the end of this year. By the end of next year, they will have finished work on the new stadium. The fantastic modern buildings have been designed by Kurt Gunter. Everybody will be watching anxiously as the new buildings go up. We are all very excited and are looking forward to the Olympic Games, because they have never been held before in this country.

grammar_points.name: 将来完成时 will have + 过去分词
by + 将来时间点(到…之前)
对比:一般将来 vs 将来完成
将来进行时 will be + doing
将来被动 will be + 过去分词
look forward to + 动名词(辅考)
as = 因为 / 当(状语从句连词,辅考)
